SELECT ifpp.finance_purchase_id, nvl(ifpi.investment_amount, 0) AS investment_amount, nvl( ifpr.purchase_redeemed_amount, 0 ) AS purchase_redeemed_amount FROM inv_finance_purchase ifpp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(ifp.investment_amount) AS investment_amount, ifp.parent_purchase_id FROM inv_finance_purchase ifp WHERE ifp.purchase_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY parent_purchase_id ) ifpi ON ifpp.parent_purchase_id = ifpi.parent_purchase_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(ifr.redemption_amount) AS purchase_redeemed_amount, purchase_id FROM inv_finance_redeem ifr WHERE ifr.redemption_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY purchase_id ) ifpr ON ifpp.parent_purchase_id = ifpr.purchase_id
ifpp.finance_purchase_id = #{financePurchaseId}
mapper.update: update inv_finance_purchase ifp SET ifp.detail_date_id = #{detailDateId} WHERE ifp.parent_purchase_id = #{parentPurchaseId}
mapper.select: select ifps.* from (select ifp.finance_purchase_id, ifp.purchase_number, ifp.new_or_add, (select cb.bank_name from csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id=ifp.inv_bank_id ) as inv_bank_name, inp.financial_products_name, inp.financial_products_num, ifp.financial_type, ifp.purchase_date, ifp.investment_amount, ifp.annual_rate, ifp.investment_amount as real_investment_amount, ifp.purchase_status, ifp.creation_date, ifp.redeemed_amount, ifp.last_update_date from inv_finance_purchase ifp, inv_financial_products inp where ifp.finance_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId} and ifp.finance_products_id=inp.inv_products_id union select ifp.finance_purchase_id, ifp.purchase_number, ifp.new_or_add, (select cb.bank_name from csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id=ifp.inv_bank_id ) as inv_bank_name, inp.financial_products_name, inp.financial_products_num, ifp.financial_type, ifp.purchase_date, ifp.investment_amount, ifp.annual_rate, ifp.investment_amount as real_investment_amount, ifp.purchase_status, ifp.creation_date, ifp.redeemed_amount, ifp.last_update_date from inv_finance_purchase ifp, inv_financial_products inp where ifp.parent_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId} and ifp.finance_products_id=inp.inv_products_id union select ifp.finance_purchase_id, ifp.purchase_number, ifp.new_or_add, (select cb.bank_name from csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id=ifp.inv_bank_id ) as inv_bank_name, inp.financial_products_name, inp.financial_products_num, ifp.financial_type, ifp.purchase_date, ifp.investment_amount, ifp.annual_rate, ifp.investment_amount as real_investment_amount, ifp.purchase_status, ifp.creation_date, ifp.redeemed_amount, ifp.last_update_date from inv_finance_detail invv, inv_finance_redeem ifr, inv_finance_purchase ifp, inv_financial_products inp where invv.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and ifr.purchase_id=invv.inv_finance_detail_id and ifp.finance_purchase_id=invv.document_id and ifp.finance_products_id=inp.inv_products_id and (ifp.parent_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId} or ifp.finance_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId}) union select ifr.finance_redeem_id as finance_purchase_id, ifr.redemption_number as purchase_number, 'REDEEM' as new_or_add, (select cb.bank_name from csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id=ipp.inv_bank_id ) as inv_bank_name, inp.financial_products_name, inp.financial_products_num, ipp.financial_type, ifr.redemption_date as purchase_date, ifr.redemption_amount as investment_amount, ipp.annual_rate, ipp.investment_amount as real_investment_amount, ifr.redemption_status as purchase_status, ipp.creation_date, ipp.redeemed_amount, ipp.last_update_date from inv_finance_redeem ifr,inv_finance_detail idd, inv_finance_purchase ipp,inv_financial_products inp where ifr.purchase_id=idd.inv_finance_detail_id and idd.document_id=ipp.finance_purchase_id and ipp.finance_products_id=inp.inv_products_id and idd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and ifr.purchase_id in ( select ifd.inv_finance_detail_id from inv_finance_detail ifd,inv_finance_purchase ifp where ifp.finance_purchase_id=ifd.document_id and ifd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and (ifp.parent_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId} or ifp.finance_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId})) ) ifps order by ifps.last_update_date desc

select ifp.financial_type, count(*) as financial_type_count, round((count(*)/(select count(*) from inv_finance_purchase inp where inp.purchase_status in ('APPROVED','PENDING'))),2)*100 as type_count_percent, round((sum(ifp.investment_amount)/(select sum(inp.investment_amount) from inv_finance_purchase inp where inp.purchase_status in ('APPROVED','PENDING'))),2)*100 as inverstment_amount_percent, sum(ifp.investment_amount) as investment_amount from inv_finance_purchase ifp where ifp.purchase_status in ('APPROVED','PENDING') and ifp.company_id=#{request.companyId} group by ifp.financial_type

select sum(ifp.purchased_amount) as purchaseAmount, sum(ifp.redeemed_amount) as redeemAmount, (sum(ifp.purchased_amount)-sum(ifp.redeemed_amount)) as remainingRedeemAmount from inv_finance_purchase ifp where ifp.purchase_status in ('APPROVED','PENDING') and ifp.company_id=#{request.companyId} group by ifp.company_id

select sum(ifp.purchased_amount) as purchaseAmount, sum(ifp.redeemed_amount) as redeemAmount, (sum(ifp.purchased_amount)-sum(ifp.redeemed_amount)) as remainingRedeemAmount from inv_finance_purchase ifp where ifp.purchase_status in ('APPROVED','PENDING') and ifp.company_id=#{request.companyId} group by ifp.company_id

SELECT pu.*, ra.redeem_amount FROM ( SELECT pa.purchase_amount AS investment_amount, pall.financial_product_name, pall.issuing_agency, pall.expected_due_date, pall.finance_purchase_id, pall.company_id FROM ( SELECT ifp.* FROM inv_finance_purchase ifp WHERE ( TO_DAYS( now( ) ) - TO_DAYS( ifp.expected_due_date ) ) >= - #{days} ) pall, ( SELECT max( ifp.finance_purchase_id ) AS purchase_id FROM inv_finance_purchase ifp WHERE ifp.purchase_status = 'APPROVED' AND ifp.financial_type = 'CLOSE' GROUP BY ifp.parent_purchase_id ) pi, ( SELECT ifp.parent_purchase_id AS purchase_id, nvl( sum( ifp.investment_amount ), 0 ) AS purchase_amount FROM inv_finance_purchase ifp WHERE ifp.purchase_status = 'APPROVED' AND ifp.financial_type = 'CLOSE' GROUP BY ifp.parent_purchase_id ) pa WHERE pall.finance_purchase_id = pi.purchase_id AND pall.parent_purchase_id = pa.purchase_id ) pu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ifr.purchase_id, nvl( sum( ifr.redemption_amount ), 0 ) AS redeem_amount FROM inv_finance_redeem ifr WHERE ifr.redemption_status = 'APPROVED' AND ifr.purchase_financial_type = 'CLOSE' GROUP BY ifr.purchase_id ) ra ON pu.finance_purchase_id = ra.purchase_id AND ( pu.investment_amount - ra.redeem_amount ) != 0

SELECT DISTINCT sua.user_id FROM sys_user_allocation sua, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_org_position fop, fnd_org_unit fou
sua.employee_assign_id = fea.employee_assign_id AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND fop.unit_id = fou.unit_id AND fou.unit_code = #{unitCode}

SELECT fc.company_full_name as company_name, su.description as purchaseApplicantName, (select cbb.bank_name from csh_bank cbb where cbb.bank_id=ifp.inv_bank_id) as inv_bank_name, inp.financial_products_name, inp.financial_products_num, inp.financial_max_amount, fc.currency_name as currency_desc, (select nvl(sum(p.investment_amount),0) from inv_finance_purchase p where p.finance_purchase_id=31 or p.parent_purchase_id=31) as all_investment_amount, (select nvl(sum(ifd.financial_amount),0) from inv_finance_detail ifd where ifd.document_id in (select p.finance_purchase_id from inv_finance_purchase p where p.finance_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId} or p.parent_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId}) and ifd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and ifd.approved_status not in ('APPROVED')) as purchasing_amount, ( select nvl(sum(idd.financial_amount),0) from inv_finance_redeem ifr,inv_finance_detail idd where idd.document_id=ifr.finance_redeem_id and idd.data_class='REDEEM' and ifr.purchase_id in (select ifd.inv_finance_detail_id from inv_finance_detail ifd where ifd.document_id in (select p.finance_purchase_id from inv_finance_purchase p where p.finance_purchase_id= #{financePurchaseId} or p.parent_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId}) and ifd.data_class in ('NEW_PURCHASE','ADD_PURCHASE') and ifd.approved_status in ('APPROVED')) and idd.approved_status in ('APPROVING')) as redeeming_amount, ifp.* from inv_finance_purchase ifp ,fnd_company fc,sys_user su, inv_financial_products inp,fnd_currency fc where 1=1 AND ifp.company_id = fc.company_id AND ifp.purchase_applicant = su.user_id and inp.inv_products_id=ifp.finance_products_id and fc.currency_code=ifp.currency and ifp.finance_purchase_id=#{financePurchaseId}
